idea-plugin.name: LLM Subscription Usage
idea-plugin.description:
Track and use your LLM subscriptions directly in the IDE.

  • Quota at a glance — usage for OpenAI (ChatGPT/Codex), Claude, SuperGrok/xAI, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, OpenCode Go and Zen (Console browser login), Ollama Cloud, Z.ai, MiniMax, Mistral, and Kimi in the status bar or main toolbar, with a detailed popup showing usage windows and reset times. Add more than one login per provider when you need it.
  • MCP tools — quota lookup, subscription-backed web search (OpenAI/Codex, SuperGrok/xAI, Mistral, Kimi, Z.ai, MiniMax, Ollama), web fetch (Ollama, Z.ai), image generation (OpenAI/Codex, SuperGrok/xAI Imagine, Mistral, Z.ai GLM-Image, MiniMax) with optional file output, SuperGrok image edits (no masks), video generation (SuperGrok/xAI Imagine, Z.ai CogVideoX), document-to-markdown (Mistral OCR, Z.ai GLM-OCR, OpenAI/Codex, SuperGrok), speech-to-text (OpenAI/Codex, SuperGrok/xAI, Mistral, Z.ai, MiniMax), and text-to-speech (OpenAI/Codex, SuperGrok/xAI, Mistral, MiniMax). Served through IntelliJ's built-in MCP server to the IDE's AI chat and to any external MCP-capable agent.
  • Local OpenAI-compatible proxy — expose selected subscriptions (OpenAI/Codex, SuperGrok, GitHub Copilot, Kimi, MiniMax, Mistral, Ollama, OpenCode Zen, Z.ai) through standard OpenAI/LiteLLM endpoints, so tools like JetBrains Junie can use them as a custom LLM provider. Optional FIM adapter on /v1/completions for JetBrains AI Completion via the stable model id qwen2.5-coder. Compatibility is tested with the Junie CLI and JetBrains' API Connections for AI features such as the integrated chat.
  • MCP server URL sync — keeps JSON, TOML, and YAML client config files pointed at IntelliJ's active MCP endpoint when its port changes.

All credentials are stored in IntelliJ Password Safe.
